Then locate a template for carbamate formation (Boc protection) by reacting a secondary amine with tert‑butyl chloroformate. Finally, locate a Buchwald‑Hartwig C–N coupling template to connect the piperazine nitrogen to an aryl bromide. After obtaining suitable template IDs, I will verify each step and check that the leaf precursors are commercially available.</thought>
